description: Check that a purchase receipt is genuine. Use it when you or your principal need proof of what was bought and paid. Pass the receipt object exactly as purchase or order_status returned it. Returns whether the receipt's signature is valid and whether it matches its entry in the store's hash-chained ledger. Read-only; nothing is changed or charged.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

receipt.description: The receipt object exactly as purchase or order_status returned it

name: verify_receipt
title: Verify a receipt
